Opening hours and contact

Our store in Berlin is open six days a week. We are happy to help you find the right tool for your project, and you can always call us before you visit to check that an item is in stock.

Opening hours

Monday to Friday
8:00 to 18:00
Saturday
9:00 to 14:00

Directions

The store is a short walk from the Haus der Kunst gallery and the old bridge that locals call die Brücke. Take the tram to the main square, then follow the river for about five minutes until you see our green sign.

Store news

We now stock garden tools from local makers.

Contact

Call us or send a message. Prices include VAT.

We reply within one working day.
